blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Complex image editing requires faithful task interpretation and accurate execution, but a failed edit does not reveal which responsibility failed. We present DuplexBridge, which uses a unified model's own understanding capability to enhance prompts for its own generation capability, without an external understanding module. A source-grounded bridge specifies targets, final-state changes, and preservation constraints. Understanding is supervised on fidelity to the original request without observing the generated image; generation is supervised on execution of the condition it actually receives. Reciprocal trust checks selectively admit global task feedback to each role while retaining independently valid local supervision. We introduce CE-Bench, a 1,200-task benchmark measuring joint satisfaction of task-derived change and preservation requirements. Across three model configurations, the full system improves complete compliance over direct editors by 21.75-25.75 percentage points, with gains also observed on KRIS-Bench, RISEBench, ImgEdit, and GEdit-Bench. From a common supervised Wan-Image initialization, gated joint training reaches 77.08% complete compliance, compared with 70.92% without gates and 75.00% when generation-local supervision instead checks the original task with both gates retained. These results support distinct local responsibilities and selective shared feedback for joint understanding-generation adaptation.
blocks.zh: 复杂的图像编辑需要忠实的任务解释和准确的执行,但失败的编辑并不能显示哪个责任失败了. 我们提出"双相通"(DuplexBridge),它使用一个统一的模型自己的理解能力来增强自身的生成能力的快感,而没有外部的理解模块. 以源为底的桥梁具体规定了目标、最终状态变化和保存限制。 在不观察生成的图像的情况下,在忠实于原始请求的情况下,对理解进行监督;在实际获得的条件执行时,对生成进行监督。 对等信托检查有选择地接受对每个角色的全球任务反馈,同时保留独立有效的地方监督. 我们采用了CE-Bench,这是一个1 200个任务基准,衡量任务产生的变化和保存要求的共同满意度。 在三个模型配置中,整个系统比直接编辑改进了21.75-25.75个百分点的完全合规性,在KRIS-Bench、RISE-Bench、ImgEdit和Gedit-Bench上也观察到收益。 从共同监督的Wan-Image初始化情况来看,门式联合培训达到77.08%的完全合规率,而70.92%没有门;75.0%的代地监督则保留了两个门,以检查原先的任务。 这些结果支持了独特的地方责任和有选择地共享反馈,以便共同理解-生成适应。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
MGIE learns expressive instructions and jointly trains the multimodal language
model and image editor ( Fu et al., 2024 ) .
SmartEdit strengthens complex instruction editing with bidirectional interaction
between image features and MLLM outputs ( Huang et al., 2024 ) .
These works establish understanding-guided editing and coupled adaptation;
SmartEdit’s bidirectionality concerns feature interaction, whereas ours concerns
training feedback between the understanding and generation roles.
BAGEL unifies image understanding and generation; Uni-Edit studies editing-driven
adaptation ( Deng et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) .
Unified Thinker uses successive understanding and generation phases, ThinkGen
applies SepGRPO, and ThinkRL-Edit decouples the two roles’ updates ( Zhou et al., 2026 ; Jiao et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) .
UniGRPO and BRAID further study joint reasoning and synthesis ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) .
DuplexBridge focuses on the supervision references and feedback eligibility
within this co-adaptation: task fidelity, received-condition execution, and
task outcome train distinct loss components.
Here, native understanding means that the unified model uses its own
understanding capability for prompt enhancement and passes the result to its
own generation capability, without an external understanding module in that
inference path. This definition permits external judges and teachers for
training supervision.

blocks.en:
PromptEnhancer optimizes a rewriter with a frozen generator; its published
alignment reward evaluates generated images against the rewritten prompt ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Thus, received-condition image assessment is
already an established component. Wan-Image and SenseNova-U1.5 use structured
editing conditions ( Mao et al., 2026 ; Diao et al., 2026 ) .
DDA-Thinker already assesses executable plans without observing generated
images and maintains separate cognitive and visual reward streams, while
keeping the editor frozen ( Yang et al., 2026 ) .
DARS addresses the same ambiguity between planning and execution failures.
It jointly trains a planner and renderer with an original-task checklist,
post-render planner diagnostics, prefix gating across plan fields, and
variance-based module weights ( Cao et al., 2026 ) .
DuplexBridge combines different local references within co-adaptation:
U-local judges task fidelity without the rendered image, and G-local judges
execution against the condition actually received. Reciprocal partner trust
selects only the additional global losses, preserving valid local supervision
when global feedback is withheld. This combination makes local responsibility
and global-feedback eligibility explicit within the same training procedure.
The gates implement selective feedback, not counterfactual credit estimation ( Foerster et al., 2018 ) .

blocks.en: 3.3 Source binding, coverage, and validity
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 来源约束、覆盖范围和有效性

blocks.en:
The bridge supports recoloring, replacement, insertion, removal, movement,
text transformation, and observable state changes. It expresses the requested
terminal state, including exact final text or a reasoning-derived value,
rather than an unresolved instruction to reason. Editable and protected source
content have disjoint roles. Targets must resolve to a source instance or a
determinate set; matching the edited output retains that source identity.
Sharing a description does not guarantee that U, G, and a visual judge interpret
it identically.

Each execution group conjoins source grounding, applicable initial-state
checks, and the corresponding output requirement. A failed or unresolved
prerequisite marks its group as non-passing once; training eligibility is
assessed separately. Preservation requirements reuse source evidence and are
deduplicated or partitioned when scopes overlap, so repeated wording does not
increase reward weight. These reduction rules also apply to public evaluation,
whose requirements come from the original task rather than the predicted bridge.

blocks.en: 8 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 8 讨论和限制

blocks.en:
DuplexBridge improves joint task fulfillment by separating local supervision
references and selecting additional global feedback. Its checks remain
semantic judgments: a shared condition does not guarantee correct source
binding or visual assessment. Unresolved judgments abstain, and high reward
confidence alone does not establish correctness.

DouplexBridge通过分离地方监督改进联合任务的执行
参考和选择额外的全球反馈。 检查还在
语义判断:共享条件不能保证正确的源
约束性或视觉评估。 未解决的判决弃权,高赏罚
仅仅信任并不能证明正确。

blocks.en:
Mean execution thresholds
can also admit a failed critical requirement when other groups pass
( section 4.4 ).
The gates define selective objectives rather than counterfactual attribution
or unbiased unconditional-return optimization ( section 4.4 ).
The random-selection controls narrow some group-structure differences but do
not uniquely separate sample quality from optimizer exposure. Structure–gate
and reward–gate interactions describe aggregate endpoints; checkpoint
cross-pairing describes partner dependence within the evaluated run.
blocks.zh:
平均执行阈值
当其他团体通过时,也可以接受失败的关键要求
(第4.4节)。
门定义了选择性目标,而不是相反的事实归属
或无偏见的无条件返回优化(第4.4节)。
随机选择控制一些组结构差异, 但确实
并非与最佳接触物单独分离的样本质量。 结构-门
和奖励 - 门交互描述总终点; 检查站
交叉铺平描述评估运行中伙伴的依赖性.

blocks.en:
The observed requirement-load strata differ in task-category composition.
Their contrasts do not identify a causal effect of complexity, and higher
aggregate CCR coexists with some component regressions. Human evaluation
supports an instruction-fulfillment gain on the matched population, while
preservation and quality intervals against ungated include zero. These
comparisons do not establish visual-quality non-inferiority. Reported
bootstrap intervals quantify task-sampling uncertainty conditional on the
evaluated outputs and labels, rather than variation across new training runs.

The text-to-image extension uses task-specific retraining and a redesigned
interface; it is not zero-shot transfer from editing checkpoints. Our
experiments have not evaluated more complex video generation or editing.
Extending the method to the video domain remains a direction for future work.

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en:
DuplexBridge connects a unified model’s own understanding and generation
through a checkable editing condition. Local supervision distinguishes task
fidelity from received-condition execution, while reciprocal trust gates
select additional global feedback and retain valid local learning.
Across three configurations, complete compliance improves over direct editors;
controlled Wan-Image comparisons support the supervision references and
semantic selection, with gains also supported by human evaluation.
These findings support separating local responsibilities when jointly
adapting understanding and generation.
blocks.zh:
双相桥连接一个统一的模型自身的理解和生成
通过可检查的编辑条件。 地方监督区分任务
接受条件处决的忠诚,对等信任门
选择额外的全球反馈并保留有效的本地学习。
在三种配置中,完全合规比直接编辑改进;
控制 万象比较支持监督参考和
语义选择,所得也得到人类评价的支持.
这些调查结果支持将地方责任分开,如果联合
适应理解和生成。
